cskg_question_anchor_fusion.selection_criterion: Choose the weight with maximum overall recall@10 among candidates whose detector-feature distinctness is at least 0.90 in every task; break exact recall ties toward the lower question weight.
cskg_question_anchor_fusion.selected_weight_justification: 0.10 satisfies the per-task detector-feature floor and has the highest recall@10 (0.8226) in the preregistered sweep; it also exceeds the 0.35 diagnostic row (0.7683).

gates.C_justification: The frozen route_for_state policy never selects vanilla_rag; Gate C therefore tests selective abstention versus the retrieval baselines, not routing among retrieval strategies.
gates.E_justification: The proposal requires recovery exceeding the published +9-point pipeline gain out of the +24-point oracle opportunity: 9/24 = 0.375 of the oracle gap.
